creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3 sections 1 and 12, stage 3.

- `MusterSessions.app` runs `muster-daemon` instead of herdr; same bundle id `dev.amterp.muster.sessions`, same Launch Services start, usage strings and entitlement. The daemon opts out of App Nap and timer coalescing.
- The app bundle carries the Linux daemons under `Contents/Resources`; a remote install copies the matching one to `~/.muster/daemon/<version>/` and starts it with `setsid`. A remote Mac gets the app's arm64 daemon. No download, no pin.
- `release.yml` builds the Linux daemons into the bundle; `--ssh` installs a daemon built from the commit under test.
- devenv: fake agents that detection recognizes, `devenv/config.toml` and `install-daemon` updated; the `corpus-linux` workflow either builds the daemon in its job to keep a Linux-vs-macOS diff, or is retired.
- Release notes for the cut: old herdr daemons keep running until their panes end, the new app does not show them, and how to stop them.
title: Ship muster-daemon: helper app, bundled Linux daemons, remote install
